1_executive_email.body:
Dear Medical device OEM with implantable power management pipeline (Medtronic Technology Scouting / R&D Leadership,

I am writing to present a technology-transfer opportunity that may be of strategic interest to Medical device OEM with implantable power management pipeline (Medtronic.

## Technology
P-15 — Cardiac motion energy harvesting (1-40 μW) + 100μF capacitor + duty-cycle

## Why This May Matter to Medical device OEM with implantable power management pipeline (Medtronic, Boston Scientific)
Hybrid power (harvesting + buffer) eliminates battery replacement for ultra-low-power implants. Platform technology.

## Current Evidence
- Technical readiness: T1
- Physical validation: NONE
- Evidence is transparent and auditable — every claim traces to a source artifact

## What Is NOT Proven (Honest Disclosure)
- Zero-harvest death in 0.1h (no backup battery)
- Arrhythmia model (70% reduction) more aggressive than published (10-30%)

## What We Are Asking
Commission the decisive experiment ($5-10K (ESTIMATED: bench setup + harvesting module)) OR request technical diligence OR request co-development discussion. Licensing is a subsequent route after successful validation.

## Validation Investment
A defined experiment ($$5-10K physical test, 6-12 months to T2) can upgrade this from T1 to externally verified status.

## Next Step
If this is of interest, I would welcome a 30-minute call to discuss:
1. Whether this fits your strategic roadmap
2. What evidence you would need to evaluate further
3. Whether a sponsored validation or co-development structure makes sense

I can share the full technical dossier under NDA.

Best regards,
[CEO Name]
CereVascular
